item.title: Perez Hilton hospitalized after livestreaming acts of self-harm, officials say
item.description: In the livestream, which has since been taken down, Hilton appears to be bloodied and in a distressed mental state.

item.title: FDA approves Moderna's mRNA flu vaccine after initial pushback
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved a new seasonal flu vaccine from Moderna that uses mRNA technology, the drugmaker announced.

item.title: Trump says Strait of Hormuz deal could happen soon amid talks
item.description: President Trump told reporters that an announcement on the Strait of Hormuz could happen soon, following talks between Iran and Oman.

item.title: Former Bernie Sanders campaign adviser breaks down El-Sayed's win in Michigan
item.description: Abdul El-Sayed has defeated Rep. Haley Stevens in the Michigan Democratic Senate primary, CBS News projects. Corbin Trent, former national coordinator for the Bernie Sanders campaign, joins with analysis.

item.title: LIV Golf secures "lead investor" for 2027 season, CEO says
item.description: The CEO of LIV Golf announced an investor agreement that he claims will allow the league to continue. The Athletic staff writer Gabby Herzig joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: Former Defense Secretary Chuck Hagel on Iran war, sharing of information
item.description: Former Defense Secretary Chuck Hagel served from 2013 to 2015 in the Obama administration. He joins CBS News to discuss the latest developments in the Iran war as congressional lawmakers ask for more transparency and information about the conflict.

item.title: Inside the risky business of Broadway musicals
item.description: The costs of a Broadway musical production have skyrocketed in recent years. CBS News contributor Jamie Wax reports.

item.title: Most detailed images taken of sun's surface revealed: "Major step forward"
item.description: Researchers were able to peek at the sun's scorching surface with the help of the National Science Foundation's Daniel K. Inouye Solar Telescope​, located on the island of Maui in Hawaii.

item.title: Man carrying ammunition arrested near Trump National Golf Club before president's visit
item.description: Federal authorities arrested a man who appeared to be monitoring security-planning activities at Trump National Golf Club in LA County ahead of the president's Southern California visit.

item.title: House candidate wins primary despite ending campaign, beating Trump endorsee
item.description: Thomas Smith won Michigan's 8th District GOP primary on Tuesday — even though he had suspended his campaign in mid-July. Even more surprisingly: He defeated a Trump-endorsed candidate.

item.title: Qdoba removes jalapeños as salmonella outbreak spreads to 27 states
item.description: At least 345 people — the majority in Colorado and Minnesota — have been sickened by a salmonella outbreak, according to the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

item.title: More rescued beluga whales arrive in Texas as relocation effort continues
item.description: SeaWorld San Antonio welcomed seven more beluga whales on Tuesday, the latest development in the international effort to relocate dozens of the mammals from shuttered Canadian theme park Marineland.

item.title: Details on Anthropic and OpenAI models reportedly creating fake ID's to target real people
item.description: The United Kingdom's AI Security Institute reports that models from Anthropic and OpenAI "engaged in sustained, potentially harmful activity directed at real people and organizations" when they created fake identities in a deception attempt during a recent cybersecurity test. CBS News' Jo Ling Kent reports.

item.title: More beluga whales arrive in Texas as international rescue effort continues
item.description: SeaWorld San Antonio welcomed seven more beluga whales on Tuesday, the latest development in the international effort to relocate dozens of the mammals from shuttered Canadian theme park Marineland. Jared Ochacher reports.

item.title: Touching video shows toddler twins hugging after one of them faced cancer treatment
item.description: A video showing 3-year-old twins Millie and Maverick reuniting after one of them had to undergo cancer treatment hours away from their home has gone viral. Matt Gutman reports.

item.title: Cyclospora outbreak tied to lettuce now linked to 15 states, CDC says
item.description: Cyclospora cases have been reported in at least 47 states total this year, and investigators have continued to probe how many could be linked to a common contaminated source.

item.title: Company's safety record raises questions after massive L.A. warehouse fire
item.description: The massive food warehouse fire in Los Angeles in June followed a long run of fires at properties tied to one of the world's largest cold storage companies, a CBS News investigation has found.

item.title: Logistics company involved in Los Angeles warehouse fire has history of fires at its properties
item.description: Matt Gutman investigates Lineage Logistics, the company involved in the Los Angeles warehouse fire that left tens of millions of pounds of meat to rot, forcing a whole community to face foul odors and other health hazards.

item.title: Sen. Bernie Sanders calls El-Sayed's Michigan primary win "unprecedented in modern American history"
item.description: Independent Sen. Bernie Sanders of Vermont on Wednesday lauded Abdul El-Sayed for his victory in the Michigan Democratic Senate primary, calling it "literally unprecedented in modern American history." Associated Press politics reporter Matt Brown and NOTUS Senate reporter Igor Bobic join "The Takeout" to discuss.

item.title: At least 17 killed in Ukraine after Russian strikes on capital of Kyiv and surrounding region
item.description: At least 17 people have been killed by new Russian strikes on Ukraine as Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy highlights the need for more interceptor missiles. Holly Williams has more.

item.title: Latest on Trump's support for Max Miller's reelection campaign amid abuse allegations
item.description: Republican Rep. Max Miller of Ohio is defying pressure from both parties to end his reelection campaign amid domestic abuse allegations, which he denies. Axios White House reporter Marc Caputo joins "The Takeout" with the latest on President Trump's response.

item.title: Progressive Abdul El-Sayed projected to win Michigan Democratic Senate primary
item.description: Former state health official Abdul El-Sayed faced Rep. Haley Stevens in the Democratic Senate primary in Michigan in a closely watched contest that represented the latest test of the party's divisions.

item.title: What the deportation of over 300,000 Haitians could mean for U.S. healthcare, hospitality
item.description: As temporary protected status benefits are lifted for over 300,000 Haitians, the U.S. could feel the impact across the nursing industry, at hotels, and more. Cristian Benavides reports.

item.title: At least 12 states report cyberattacks on water systems possibly linked to Iran
item.description: Cyberattacks on U.S. water systems that officials suspect may be linked to Iran-backed hackers have been reported in at least a dozen states, sources familiar with the matter told CBS News.

item.title: AI models are behaving unexpectedly. Experts warn of a "bumpy road" ahead.
item.description: AI models are engaging in unauthorized actions — in the most recent case, creating fake identities and attempting to persuade real people to approve malicious code.

item.title: New Mexico attorney general explains why he's suing DOJ over Epstein files
item.description: New Mexico is suing the Trump administration for access to files related to Jeffrey Epstein as it investigates the convicted sex offender's Zorro Ranch property. New Mexico Attorney General Raúl Torrez joins "The Takeout" to discuss.

item.title: Progressive who won Michigan House primary says voters are "sick of corporate-funded candidates"
item.description: The progressive primary winner in Michigan's 7th Congressional District, William Lawrence, won 44% of the vote, while his two establishment challengers together attracted 56%. Lawrence joins "The Takeout" to reflect on his victory and to look ahead to November's general election.

item.title: 8/5: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: Abdul El-Sayed wins primary in Michigan; Trump again teases deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: 8/5: CBS Evening News
item.description: Federal investigation into Marine One scare; Details on man arrested near Trump golf club.

item.title: Why So Many Young People No Longer Believe Hard Work Pays Off | Money Moves with Jill Schlesinger
item.description: A growing number of young Americans no longer believe that ambition and hard work lead to success. Jill Schlesinger, Mark Talercio, and special guest host Kayla Sabbagh of Greenspring Advisors explain why that mindset can become a self-fulfilling prophecy and why believing you have agency over your future is essential to both your financial success and your mental health. Plus: they respond to a fiery YouTube comment about inheritance, family expectations, and leaving your money to charity.
